svg.aria-label: Production boot ROMs: one disk step

g.text: Production boot ROMs: one disk step
A box whose boot ROM has no debug monitor (2046 and other production ROMs) needs
the Bridge's loader in a reserved area of its disk, the tier-3 area, once.
That means taking the drive out and writing 12 sectors with dd; the procedure is
under Reference, Writing the tier-3 loader to a drive. After that the Bridge keeps
the area current by itself, and the box behaves as above.
